title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 387 (Dating of prospectus and particulars to be contained therein)

content.overview: No person shall issue, circulate or distribute in India any prospectus offering to subscribe for securities of a company incorporated or to be incorporated outside India, whether or not it has established or will establish a place of business in India, unless the prospectus is dated and signed and contains the prescribed particulars (constitution instrument, enactments of incorporation, address in country of incorporation, whether it has a place of business in India and its principal office address, and the matters specified under section 26). A condition waiving compliance is void. A form of application for securities must be issued with a complying prospectus (except bona fide underwriting invitations).
content.glance: Foreign (or to-be-incorporated foreign) company prospectus issued in India must be dated and signed and contain the listed particulars and s. 26 matters; waiver conditions are void.
content.study: Section 387 regulates prospectuses offering securities of companies incorporated or to be incorporated outside India when issued, circulated or distributed in India. The prospectus must be dated and signed and must contain the constitution instrument, incorporation enactments, address in the country of incorporation, Indian place-of-business status and principal office, and the matters under section 26. Certain constitution particulars need not appear if the prospectus is issued more than two years after the company is entitled to commence business. Waiver of compliance is void. Application forms must accompany a complying prospectus except for bona fide underwriting invitations.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: A prospectus for securities of a company incorporated or to be incorporated outside India, when issued in India, must be dated and signed and contain the listed particulars and s. 26 matters.

provisions.title: Dating of prospectus and particulars to be contained therein

examples.title: Illustration — s. 387
examples.body: A Delaware company offers shares to Indian investors through a prospectus circulated in India; the prospectus must be dated and signed and contain the s. 387 particulars.

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 387?
hypotheticals.analysis: It requires dating, signature and specified particulars (including s. 26 matters) in any foreign-company prospectus issued in India.

rows.left: Dating and contents of foreign prospectus

misconceptions.trap: Assuming s. 387 applies only if the foreign company has a place of business in India.
misconceptions.correction: s. 387 applies whether or not the company has established or will establish a place of business in India.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 387 be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Confirm Indian issue/circulation of a foreign-company prospectus. II. Check dating, signature and listed particulars. III. Note void waiver and application-form rule.
